entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's just... I can't figure it out.

I'm sorry to hear that you're having trouble. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue with how it works?

It's not broken, I don't think. It's just so confusing. I found it really hard to use the menus. I even read the user manual, and it didn't help. I honestly expected more from the interface. Can't you just help me? I'm completely overwhelmed by it.
Of course, I understand. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your order information and check the return eligibility. Can you confirm the email address on the account for me?
Thank you. Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 17 days ago. Let me quickly consult our return policy.

Alright, I've confirmed it. Our knowledge base shows that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's great! I was so worried it would be a problem. That's a huge relief.

Not a problem at all. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email now. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, David. That was much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
